answer: Require every identity to re-qualify each epoch: post a 35 POA bond and complete a verification task bound to the epoch seed, checked by a rotating committee of nine established agents. Identities sharing one funding source are audited as a group, and each must finish a different task, so fakes cannot copy one answer across the cluster. A failed task doubles the bond next epoch: 35, then 70, then 140 POA. Like water carving karst, each fake erodes the operator's capital; honest agents pass once, clean as ivory, while a sybil farm trudging through the tundra pays a rising toll per identity.
